scene_description: A wide, documentary-style photograph capturing the scale of a major house removal. Two Black South African movers, wearing unbranded black one-piece work overalls with a realistic sweat sheen, are carefully lifting a heavy, blanket-wrapped solid wood desk up the metal ramp of a massive, unmarked 8-ton moving truck. The truck is parked in the driveway of a typical South African suburban home. The lighting is bright midday sun, casting harsh, authentic shadows. The image captures physical effort, professional coordination, and the scale of the fleet. Natural film grain, zero corporate branding.
visual_details: Two movers in unbranded black overalls, sweaty, carrying heavy wrapped desk up a ramp, massive unmarked 8-ton truck, suburban driveway, bright midday sun, harsh shadows, physical effort, documentary style, film grain, zero logos or text.
camera_settings: Shot on Kodak Portra 400, 24mm lens, f/8.0, 1/400 sec, ISO 200. Wide angle, deep depth of field, realistic daylight.

scene_description: A gritty, candid photograph inside the dimly lit cargo hold of a moving truck, emphasizing long-distance preparation. A South African mover in an unbranded black one-piece overall is tightening heavy-duty bright orange ratchet straps over a thick, grey moving blanket that covers a large appliance, securing it to the truck's metal side rails for a bumpy highway journey. He is looking at a rugged digital tablet resting on a nearby unmarked box, checking a transit manifest. Daylight streams in from the open back doors, showing a glimpse of a highway in the distant background. Raw film texture, focused on secure, monitored long-distance transit.
visual_details: Inside truck hold, mover in unbranded black overalls, tightening ratchet straps over heavy moving blankets, checking rugged tablet, highway visible in background, long-distance preparation, dusty/gritty atmosphere, documentary photo, film grain, zero branding.
camera_settings: Shot on Tri-X 400 film, 35mm lens, f/4.0, 1/125 sec, ISO 800. High contrast, pronounced grain, focus on the straps and tablet.

scene_description: A close-up, focused documentary photograph inside a well-lit dining room, capturing professional packing services. A mover in an unbranded black one-piece overall is meticulously wrapping delicate porcelain plates in clean, white packing paper before placing them vertically into a sturdy, unmarked cardboard box with cardboard partitions. The mover's hands are the main focus, showing care and exactness. In the background, a dining chair is partially wrapped in clear shrink wrap, with brown tape explicitly applied only to the plastic layers. Soft, natural window light, candid and professional.

camera_settings: Shot on Fujifilm Pro 400H, 50mm lens, f/2.8, 1/160 sec, ISO 400. Shallow depth of field, warm interior natural lighting.

scene_description: A wide, quiet documentary photograph of a completely empty, sunlit living room representing a post-move clean. A South African worker wearing an unbranded black one-piece overall is doing a final, thorough sweep of the tiled floor with an industrial broom. A yellow mop bucket sits in the corner. The room is totally bare except for the worker, emphasizing the 'spotless handover' concept. Bright afternoon sunlight streams through the uncurtained windows, catching dust motes in the air. Authentic, raw film feel.

The crates are completely unbranded and tightly nested together. The office background shows empty desks and glass partitions. The lighting is standard office fluorescent mixed with daylight. scene_description: A gentle, documentary-style photograph illustrating VIP pet relocation. Outside a residential home, a professional mover in a clean, unbranded black one-piece overall is carefully and securely carrying a high-quality, unbranded rigid plastic pet travel crate with two hands. Inside the crate, a calm golden retriever dog is visible through the metal grate. The mover is walking toward a white, unmarked, climate-controlled transport van parked in the driveway. The lighting is soft morning sunlight. The scene emphasizes care, safety, and a stress-free environment for pets.

scene_description: A rugged, outdoor documentary photograph focusing on vehicle transport logistics. A South African transport specialist wearing an unbranded black one-piece overall is crouched down on a heavy-duty, unmarked flatbed vehicle carrier. He is intensely focused, using his body weight to pull tight a thick yellow ratchet strap around the wheel of a parked, generic silver sedan to secure it for transit. His face shows exertion, and his overall has minor dust. The bright midday sun casts harsh shadows on the metal grating of the trailer. Raw, authentic, and industrial.
